title: Wellhead Pumpers
description: Operate power pumps and auxiliary equipment to produce flow of oil or gas from wells in oil field.

tasks.text: Monitor pumps and flow lines for gas and fluid leaks.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.
Inspect gas systems or components to identify leaks or other potential hazards.

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Weight/volume calculations from given data

dwas.name: Calculate weights, volumes or other characteristics of materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start compressor engines and divert oil from storage tanks into compressor units and auxiliary equipment to recover natural gas from oil.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment

tasks.text: Monitor control panels during pumping operations to ensure that materials are being pumped at the correct pressure, density, rate, and concentration.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Gauge reading requires physical presence

dwas.name: Monitor equipment gauges or displays to ensure proper operation.

tasks.text: Operate engines and pumps to shut off wells according to production schedules, and to switch flow of oil into storage tanks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment

tasks.text: Repair gas and oil meters and gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Precision hand repair of delicate devices

tasks.text: Perform routine maintenance on vehicles and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical vehicle maintenance work

dwas.name: Maintain vehicles in good working condition.

tasks.text: Open valves to return compressed gas to bottoms of specified wells to repressurize them and force oil to surface.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control of pumping equipment
physical manipulation — Installing parts requires hands-on mechanical work

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.
Install machine or equipment replacement parts.

tasks.text: Prepare trucks and equipment necessary for the type of pumping service required.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lab equipment setup

dwas.name: Set up laboratory or field equipment.

tasks.text: Attach pumps and hoses to wellheads.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses requires physical fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Mix acids, chemicals, or dry cement as required for a specific job.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical preparation requires hands-on handling

tasks.text: Unload and assemble pipes and pumping equipment, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing parts requires hands-on mechanical work

dwas.name: Install parts, assemblies, or attachments in transportation or material handling equipment.

tasks.text: Supervise oil pumpers and other workers engaged in producing oil from wells.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material handling direction is on-floor supervision

dwas.name: Direct material handling or moving activities.
